rows.resolution_note: Rule C: sentence 2 of p001 defines the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data by its procedure and measurement (cis-vQTL mapping for 2,923 plasma proteins, by ancestry group), beyond a number of participants; 52,706 and the per-ancestry counts equal no dictionary row's N and no release identifier or citation is given.
rows.quote: We systematically mapped cis -vQTLs for 2,923 plasma proteins in 52,706 UK Biobank participants of European (EUR, N = 45,486), African (AFR, N = 1,336), and Central/South Asian (CSA, N = 934) ancestries, identifying 2,162 vQTLs (P VE < 5 x 10 -8 ) for 781 proteins.
